title: Raw agricultural digestate characterization for membrane recovery tests
license: CC BY 4.0, as stated in the published article
material_scope: Agricultural digestate from a mesophilic cow-manure and lignocellulosic energy-crop digester; not grass-only and not GreenHub digestate
basis: As-received raw digestate; source-reported means and standard deviations retained
method: TS, VS, COD, TKN, ammonium, and phosphorus by APHA Standard Methods; pH and EC with a portable analyzer; K by Hach Lange spectrophotometry
limitations: Reference-only comparator; not a GreenHub feed characterization or process default.
Plant sampling year and replicate count are not stated in the extracted table text.
